etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from French brassière. Doublet of brachiaria.

definitions.definition: Dated form of bra (“item of underwear”). [from 1900s]

quote.citation: 2019, Chigozie Obioma, An Orchestra of Minorities, Abacus (2019), page 29:
quote.text: She started to strap her brassiere over her breasts.
